open_science_requirements: CC-09: Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences common to all fields, including digital ones (e.g. generative AI), and foster the culture of Open Science, knowledge valorisation, innovation and entrepreneurship where applicable, and good scientific conduct such as research integrity.

SR-07: Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences including digital skills (e.g. generative AI), Open Science, knowledge valorisation, and research integrity, and prepare fellows for increased research collaboration enabled by new digital technologies (FAIR data management, open access, citizen science).
